[[Tembarr Treefall]] is a [[Warden]] [[boss]] that can be encountered in the [[The Eternal Grove (explorable area)|Eternal Grove]] [[explorable area]].

== Locations ==
* [[Echovald Forest]]
** {{NPC location|The Eternal Grove|explorable area}}

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|"None Shall Pass!"}}
* {{skill icon|Counter Blow}}
* {{skill icon|Devastating Hammer}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Healing Signet}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[The Ugly Stick]] ([[unique]])
* [[Warden Horn]]

== Notes ==
* Tembarr can be pulled away from his Warden group.

== Trivia ==
* Tembarr's first name may be intended as a misspelling of "Timber!" (usually yelled when felling trees).
